shortDescription: Let the agent already present in a conversation answer through inspectable original music.
longDescription: Refrain lets an agent author an original musical gesture or complete piece, let the person hear it and inspect its structure in an interactive Canvas, export the exact portable artifact, and continue it later as a revision, extension, reply, variation, or quotation. The agent composes the music; Refrain provides a strict AIR language, deterministic compilation, exact receipts, user-gesture playback, and stateless continuity without a hidden composing model or hosted work library.
starterPrompts: Hum a short musical reply to this moment.
Turn this feeling into an original Refrain air I can hear and continue.
Continue the last Refrain air as a transformed return.

currentCapabilityBoundary.serverState: No server-owned musical object or work library.
currentCapabilityBoundary.modelBoundary: The host agent composes; Refrain does not call a composing model.
currentCapabilityBoundary.publicCanvas: Eight project-original zero-asset synth identities are executable; exact sample-backed embodiments remain canonical but unavailable without their assets.
